div.head: Grið 10
div.ab: ⁊ gif hwa gefeohteð on mynstre butan cyrcean, gebete eall mid fulre bote þæt þærto gebyrige be mynstres mæðe.
And gif hwa gefeohteð on mynstre butan cyrcean, gebete eall mid fulre bote þæt þærto gebyrige be mynstres mæðe.
Und wenn einer ficht in einem Kloster ausserhalb der Kirche, büsse er mit voller Busse alles was dort[igem Orte] zukommt gemäss dem Range des Klosters.
And if anyone fights in a minster outside the church, let him atone with full compensation for all that is due to [that place] according to the rank of the minster.
And if anyone fights within the minster close outside a church, he is to compensate for all with the full penalty to which the church is entitled according to its status.
